purpose: Validate that the Question Investigation Workbench (S900 May Administration P1 module) has a complete artifact-side contract. The workbench itself is not built — this validates that when it is built, the Certification Scan Artifact provides all necessary data.

requirement_mapping.requirement: Display item identity: QID, pack, section, question_state, template family, variant position
requirement_mapping.artifact_source: Section 4 (perItemResults) — fields: QID, pack, question_state, compound_key, template_family, variant_id

requirement_mapping.requirement: Display defect inventory: all known defects with severity, gate, status, and remediation recommendations
requirement_mapping.artifact_source: Section 5 (defectInventory) — fields: defect_id, severity, gate, status, remediation_path

requirement_mapping.requirement: Display readiness status: current classification, gate results, blocking conditions
Display scan history: timestamp, version, delta changes from prior scans
Display certification history: who certified, when, under which session
requirement_mapping.artifact_source: Section 7 (lineage) — certification_events array with date, session, verifier

requirement_mapping.requirement: Display linked recommendations: REC-IDs associated with this item
Display linked sessions: sessions that reviewed or modified this item
requirement_mapping.artifact_source: Session linker index (session_linker.js output) — QID → session_id list

requirement_mapping.requirement: Display content preview: stem, choices, correct answer (admin-only, not student-visible in practice mode)
requirement_mapping.artifact_source: Direct pack file read by admin portal (not from artifact — admin has file access). Artifact section 4 carries content_hash for integrity verification.
requirement_mapping.status: SATISFIED — admin portal reads pack files directly for content display; artifact hash verifies integrity.

request_format.student_id: String — student identifier from session context
request_format.qid: String — QuestionID from the practice session
request_format.session_id: String — session in which the question was encountered
request_format.challenge_reason: Enum: ANSWER_KEY_DISPUTE, EXPLANATION_QUALITY, CONTENT_ERROR, TECHNICAL_ISSUE, OTHER

response_format.linked_rec_id: String (optional) — if existing recommendation covers this item

challenge_submission_api_contract.artifact_side_validation: Before accepting a challenge: (1) verify QID exists in artifact section 4, (2) verify item is in the learner delivery pool (question_state: Certified), (3) check if existing REC-ID covers this item (prevent S809 duplicate). After resolution: update RECOMMENDATION_REGISTRY.json with closure evidence.

s204_spec_alignment.alignment: FULL — all 8 CWR requirements map to fields in the S202.1 artifact schema. The S204 spec references the same IQ-001 through IQ-007 query model. The investigation workflow (Student→Challenge→Admin→Resolution) defined in S202.1 Investigation Linkage is contractually complete.
s204_spec_alignment.gaps: NONE — when S900 begins May Administration P1 implementation, the artifact-side contract requires no modifications.

verdict: REQUIREMENTS VALIDATED — All 8 Challenge Workbench data requirements are satisfied by the S202.1 artifact schema. All 7 IQ queries are resolvable. The challenge submission API contract is defined. No artifact schema modifications needed for S900 implementation.
